# ADR-003: Require PHP 8.2+ (drop 8.0 and 8.1)

<!-- Generated by seed-golden-context | Last updated: 2026-05-11 -->

## Status

Accepted

## Context

PHP 8.0 reached end-of-life (EOL) in November 2023. PHP 8.1 reached EOL in November 2024. Maintaining CI matrix coverage and dependency compatibility for EOL PHP versions adds ongoing cost with no user benefit, as production deployments should not be running EOL PHP.

The v10.0.0 release (April 2026) was the natural opportunity to clean up EOL support as part of a major version bump that also added Laravel 13 support.

## Decision

Bump the `composer.json` `require.php` constraint to `^8.2` and remove PHP 8.0/8.1 from the CI matrix. This was done in commit `9b73bd3` (`feat!: add Laravel 13 support, drop EOL PHP 8.0/8.1, bump to v10.0.0`).

## Consequences

- Users on PHP 8.0 or 8.1 must use `contentful/laravel` v9.x.
- Static analysis (`phpstan`) and test runs only need to target 8.2+.
- Future EOL drops (PHP 8.2 EOL: Dec 2026) should follow the same pattern: drop in a major version bump.
